# unicode-width data

The Go width data and state machine preserve unicode-width 0.1.14, Unicode 15.1.0, used by the frozen Rust reference. Source: https://github.com/unicode-rs/unicode-width/tree/v0.1.14. The Rust Project Developers hold the upstream copyright; this adaptation uses its MIT license (Apache-2.0 alternative retained). Production uses only generated Go data and code, with no Rust runtime or cgo.
